name: Zoroastrian Priests
overview: Scripture reveals that Zoroastrian priests, often identified with magicians, astrologers, and soothsayers in the Persian and Babylonian courts, were seen as representatives of false spiritual powers distinct from the one true God. The Bible contrasts their wisdom and practices with the sovereignty of God, as seen when Daniel's God alone interprets dreams and reveals truth, while these priests fail. Furthermore, the prophetic word in Jeremiah condemns the gods they serve as powerless idols, destined to perish, emphasizing the futility of their worship compared to the living Creator. This perspective calls believers to trust in God's wisdom and authority rather than the occult or pagan religious figures of their day.
